items.quote: In a cyclic quadrilateral, each two opposite angles are supplementary.
items.claim: Theorem 3: In a cyclic quadrilateral, each two opposite angles are supplementary.

items.quote: Given: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral.
items.text: Given: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. R.T.P: Prove that: (1) m(∠A) + m(∠C) = 180°; (2) m(∠B) + m(∠D) = 180°

items.quote: Proof:
items.caption: Circle with centre dot and inscribed quadrilateral ABCD (A top, B right, C bottom right, D left), used for the proof of Theorem 3.

items.quote: m (∠A) = 1/2 m (BCD)
items.text: Proof: since m(∠A) = 1/2 m(arc BCD), and m(∠C) = 1/2 m(arc BAD), therefore m(∠A) + m(∠C) = 1/2 [m(arc BCD) + m(arc BAD)] = 1/2 × 360° = 180°. Similarly: m(∠B) + m(∠D) = 180° (Q.E.D.)
items.notes: Proof steps recorded as one block; arcs written with arc symbol over BCD, BAD.

items.quote: The measure of the exterior angle at a vertex of a cyclic quadrilateral
items.claim: Corollary: The measure of the exterior angle at a vertex of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to the measure of the interior angle at the opposite vertex.

items.quote: AB is a diameter in circle M, AC and AD are two chords
items.stem: In the opposite figure: $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter in circle M, $\overline{AC}$ and $\overline{AD}$ are two chords in it and in one side from $\overline{AB}$. A tangent to the circle was drawn from B and intersected $\overrightarrow{AC}$ at X and $\overrightarrow{AD}$ at Y. Prove that: XYDC is a cyclic quadrilateral.
solution: ∴ $m(\angle ACB) = 90^\circ$ and $\angle ABC$ is complement to $\angle BAX$ (1)
∵ $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter and $\overrightarrow{BY}$ is tangent to the circle at B.
∴ $m(\angle ABX) = 90^\circ$ and $\angle AXB$ is complement to $\angle BAX$ (2)
∵ $\angle YDC$ is an exterior angle of the cyclic quadrilateral ABCD
∵ $\angle AXB$ is an exterior angle at the vertex of the quadrilateral XYDC and $\angle YDC$ is opposite to it.
items.notes: Solution steps 1 and 2 are marked with circled numbers 1 and 2 on the right.

learning_objectives.label: Opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral
learning_objectives.description: Calculate unknown angles (and arcs) in a cyclic quadrilateral using the fact that each two opposite angles are supplementary.

learning_objectives.label: Exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral
learning_objectives.description: Calculate angle measures using the corollary that the exterior angle at a vertex of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the interior angle at the opposite vertex.

learning_objectives.label: Prove a quadrilateral is cyclic
learning_objectives.description: Prove that a quadrilateral is cyclic using the converse (supplementary opposite angles) or an exterior angle equal to the interior opposite angle.
